cues.en: We now have everything to create the profile update route.
cues.zh: 建立更新路由所需內容都準備好了。

cues.en: So you can go to the Project Explorer.
Then you're going to go to Backend app API, then routes, then profile.
Within the profile directory we're going to create a new file that is going to be update dot pi.
Then to make things a bit easy, what you can do is we can go to create dot pi, then just copy everything, go to update dot Pi, paste it in.
cues.zh: 為了方便，到 create.py 複製全部內容，貼到 update.py。

cues.en: Then we're going to make some changes.
So we're going to import fast API.
cues.zh: 仍然匯入 FastAPI 的項目，

cues.en: That doesn't change async session the logger get session current user.
cues.zh: AsyncSession、logger、get_session 與 CurrentUser 都不變。

cues.en: Then we're not going to be using the create user profile.
We're now going to be using from the services the update user profile.
cues.zh: 改從 services 匯入 update_user_profile。

cues.en: Then import the model, then the profile, not the profile create schema.
cues.zh: 仍匯入 Profile，但不使用 ProfileCreateSchema，

cues.en: This time it's a profile update schema.
Then we can go to our router.
The prefix is still going to be slash profile.
Then the router.
This is now going to be a patch request to slash update.
Then for the response model this is going to be a profile just like that.
Then the status code is going to be HTTP 200 okay.
Then the method is going to be the update profile.
Then for the profile data this is going to be the profile update schema, then the current user, then the session.
cues.zh: profile_data 使用 ProfileUpdateSchema，再接受 current_user 與 session。

cues.en: Then within our try block we're now going to await update user profile passing in the user ID, then the profile data, then the session nothing changes.
cues.zh: try 裡呼叫 await update_user_profile，傳入 user_id、profile_data 與 session，其他不變。

cues.en: Then you're going to log and you can see profile updated for the user.
cues.zh: 再記錄「使用者個人資料已更新」，

cues.en: Then passing the user's ID like that.
Then we can return the profile.
Then for the exception block that doesn't change.
Then for the second exception block, now we're going to say failed to update the profile of all the notes.
cues.zh: 第二個 except，訊息改成無法更新使用者個人資料。這裡拼字有誤，

cues.en: This is user.
Then again to pass in the user's email.
Then let me see if this is saying so.
It means I made a mistake in the created py file.
cues.zh: 表示 create.py 也寫錯了。

cues.en: Let me see.
Yeah, change that to user notes.
I'm sorry.
Then let's go back to the update.py file, then the status code internal server error then failed to update user profile.
cues.zh: 回到 update.py，status_code 是 Internal Server Error，訊息是無法更新使用者個人資料。

cues.en: Then please try again later.
Then you can save that file.
Good.
That's it for the profile update service.
cues.zh: 個人資料更新這部分就完成了。

cues.en: In the next lecture we shall be adding the update route to our main router, then testing the user profile update in postman.
cues.zh: 下一堂課將路由加入主路由器，再到 Postman 測試。
